wsp_97.core_mantra: HoloIndex -> Research -> Hard Think -> Dialectic Sweep -> First Principles -> Build -> Follow WSP
wsp_97.canonical_operator_meaning: follow wsp := retrieve wsp -> retrieve evidence -> research -> micro pass -> macro pass -> hard think -> dialectic sweep -> first principles -> execute

repository_context.repo_root: explicit validator input; exact-case Git top-level
repository_context.base_commit: receipt repository_context.base_commit; exact 40-character commit; ancestor of current HEAD

resolved_evidence.confinement: reject absolute, drive, UNC, backslash, traversal, fragment, URL, directory, wrong-case, untracked, symlink, junction, and reparse paths
resolved_evidence.wsps_applied_cross_check: every declared WSP requires a retrieved canonical path; retrieved precedents may exceed declarations

validator.opaque_evidence: all evidence outside action_evidence.retrieve_wsps remains opaque and is never opened or fetched
validator.legacy_mode: legacy_structural_non_admitting; diagnostic only; never exits compliant
validator.receipt_preflight: before root or Git: exact repository_context/base syntax, expected-base syntax/equality, retrieve_wsps count/path/case, and WSP identifier syntax; malformed receipt exits 1, malformed caller expected-base exits 2
validator.root_preflight: lstat every supplied root component before exists, directory, resolve, or Git operations; reject symlink, junction, and reparse components
validator.truth_boundary: Receipt v1.1 validates structural completeness, canonical tracked Retrieve WSPs paths, and invoking-worktree base ancestry; it does not authenticate non-WSP evidence, reasoning quality, runtime side effects, or an immutable final snapshot.

wsp_97.rubik_context: Rubik = MVP DAE. Currently 'Cubes' (modules) need Qwen/Gemma enhancement to become fully agentic Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) that connect ubiquitously to any blockchain via FoundUp MCPs.
